newsitem.title: JAPAN: Toyota may bid for former Japan Railway land - paper.
newsitem.headline: Toyota may bid for former Japan Railway land - paper.

text.p: Toyota Motor Corp is considering participating in a public auction for land in central Tokyo once used as the headquarters for the former Japanese National Railways, the Nihon Keizai Shimbun business daily reported on Thursday.
But a spokesman for the company said: "Nothing has been decided yet."
Japan's largest car maker envisages using the 12,000 sq metres of land, with an estimated value of more than 200 billion yen, for its Tokyo head office, the newspaper said.
The company also plans to join hands with trading houses to build a large multi-purpose event complex on Tokyo's waterfront, the paper said.
The amount of investment in the complex is expected to reach 10-20 billion yen.
